name: Vícar (Spain)
description: Vertically divided red and green in the proportions 1:2, the red charged with the crowned municipal arms of Vícar (a church on white above a cross and a leaf on red).
history: Vícar adopted its arms officially on 9 December 1985 and its flag on 8 November 2007; the flag is a rectangular cloth one and a half times longer than wide, the third nearest the staff red and the remaining two thirds green.

features.role: Vícar arms — church, cross and leaf
